absolutePaths: deliberate non-live /fixture placeholders: do not replay; clone and identity-verify/rebind for target OS first
immutableFiles: all managed files hashed in corpus manifest; no user data
pendingOperations: one running partial import and one queued skipped-unavailable Shelf export; normal restart must reconcile
pendingRemoval: pre-move removal intent with managed bytes still present
published: profile root decides authority; phase alone is insufficient
reserved: source authoritative before durable profile commit
